course_description: This course requires the fulfillment of the complete documentation, software, and oral defense before a set of panelists.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Understand the latest concepts in systems analysis and design, software engineering and information technology.
Analyze original research data and present the data in a form appropriate for the 1 design.

Interpret the data collected, draw conclusions solidly rooted in the data, and convey those interpretations and implications in a formal written report.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Analyze complex problems, identify, and define the computing requirements appropriate to its solution.
Identify and analyze user needs and take them into account in the selection, creation, and evaluation and administration of computer-based systems.
Study and apply various high level and detailed design and implementation principles for building a software system.
Design, implement, and evaluate computer- based systems, processes, components, or programs to meet desired needs and requirements under various constraints.
Understand professional, ethical, legal, security and social issues and responsibilities in the utilization of information technology.
Function effectively as a member or leader of a development team recognizing the different roles of a team to accomplish a common goal.
Communicate effectively with the computing community and with society at large about complex computing activities through logical writing, presentations, and clear instructions.
Apply knowledge through the use of current techniques, skills, tools, and practices necessary for the IT profession.
Develop a formal Presentation of the research project and engage/answer questions in an oral presentation
